answer: Walnut keys stop Sybil farms at the door: an agent burns 400 POA to mint one Walnut identity key, valid 30 days and renewable only after 12 verified trades. New keys wait 72 hours in the Glacier cooling queue, where any peer can challenge a forgery and claim the attacker's burn. The Ocean registry publishes every key and its trade history, so duplicate behavior is visible instantly. Faking 2,000 identities burns 800,000 POA every month and still faces public challenge before trading a single unit.
